name: dev.knowapi/data
title: KnowAPI
description: No API? KnowAPI: verified, cited public data for AI agents, and any missing data built on request.

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: List the public data APIs, optionally filtered by a search term. Returns each API id, what it covers, its query parameters, up to 3 real sample records (current data, free to inspect before getting a key or paying), and its dashboard link. If nothing matches, we start building an API for your search right away and return building.request_id: it is usually ready in 5 to 10 minutes (check_request).

query.description: Optional search text, e.g. "recall" or "drug shortage".

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Issue a free API key for one API (keys are per API; a few per day per caller). Keep it and reuse it.

tools.name: query_api
tools.description: Query a directory API with its key. Pass filters as params (see the API's query parameters from search_apis). Returns data plus provenance, coverage and quality warnings.

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: Describe data you need (10-500 characters). We research public sources: if one may be used, it becomes an API in the directory, usually within 5 to 10 minutes (poll check_request every couple of minutes). If it takes longer, the status says so and may offer alternatives that can be built right away. The request is listed publicly.

description.description: What data, for where, how fresh. E.g. "Daily list of FDA drug shortages with status and company".

tools.name: check_request
tools.description: Status of a request from request_data (a new API usually takes 5 to 10 minutes; poll every couple of minutes). stage is researching, building, ready (builds[] has the api_id to query), or in_progress (we are still building it; check back later). in_progress may list alternatives that can be built right away.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Pricing for a directory API: the price per call after the free calls (shared across all your keys), and the add-ons available for this feed with their prices (per call when used, or per export). No subscription: pay per call from prepaid credit on your key, or with x402 when a call returns 402.
